description: This PHP class file defines the 'planMilestonesCommands' class, providing methods to create, edit, update, and delete test plan milestones within a testing management system. It manages interactions with a milestone manager, handles user input validation, and generates data structures for UI rendering.

classes.name: planMilestonesCommands
classes.description: A class for managing milestone-related commands in test plans, including creation, editing, updating, and deletion actions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares a GUI object with default values for creating a new milestone, including tests for name uniqueness and date correctness.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Loads existing milestone data for editing, localizing date fields for display.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the process of creating a new milestone, including validation, database insertion via milestone_mgr, and user feedback.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing milestone, with validation checks for date logic and name uniqueness, then persists changes.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified milestone entry and logs the deletion event, returning UI update info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a database connection and instantiates the milestone manager.

methods.name: setAuditContext
methods.description: Sets the audit context for tracking changes.
